description: Approved isolated-checkout release policy for the ESP32-C3 Plane Radar firmware. scripts/build-release.ps1 and scripts/verify-release.ps1 both load this file; it is the single tracked source of truth for the pinned toolchain, the five release environments, their EXACT approved resource/file sizes, the required source gates, and the default-artifact identity. Any intentional change to an approved size or pin MUST edit this tracked file in the same commit.

local_only.note: Source may be hosted remotely, but a certified release must run in an isolated checkout with no configured Git remote. Release artifacts are staged under ignored release/ before explicit CI upload or local use.

tests.native_test_summary: 606 cases across 41 suite runs (native 580/39 + native-diag 5/1 + native-gfx 21/1)
tests.note: build-release records manifest.tests.native_test = native_test_summary and gates_run=true; verify-release checks manifest.tests.native_test equals this string and gates_run is true.

default_artifact.note: supermini/firmware-merged.bin is the ONLY default release image. It is flashed at offset 0x0.

required_source_gates.summary: 606 cases across 41 suite runs (native 580/39 + native-diag 5/1 + native-gfx 21/1); also runs verify-airport-data and verify-egress-policy fail-fast.
SnapshotStoreTestAccess friend seam cannot leak into a firmware build (source + live compile check).
Offline CA trust gate: 4 pinned roots, no setInsecure, CA enforced, derived-time clock, CA-authenticated cert-notBefore floor.
8 static provisioning release invariants (no WiFiManager/OTA/mDNS, closed route set, no permanent listener, no secret logging, one framebuffer, bounded portal).
10 worker source invariants + Phase 10 diag env matrix (17 tamper cases).

Source reproducibility policy: firmware envs strip project DWARF (build_unflags=-ggdb + -g0), native envs keep it, and policy carries the app_descriptor + per-env firmware_elf SHA anchors that bind the ELF proof input.

merged_layout.description: Byte-exact layout of every env's firmware-merged.bin (the SHIPPED/flashed image). build-release and verify-release re-derive these invariants directly from the packaged merged bytes (binary-safe) and NEVER trust merge.log text. The three components below are board/framework artifacts and are byte-identical across all five envs; the app region is byte-for-byte equal to that env's firmware.bin.
merged_layout.note: app_offset 65536 = 0x10000; bootloader 0x0, partitions 0x8000, boot_app0 0xe000. merged length MUST equal app_offset + firmware.bin length; the region at app_offset MUST equal firmware.bin byte-for-byte; every gap between a component end and the next offset MUST be gap_fill_byte (0xFF).

app_descriptor.description: Fixed location and format of the ESP-IDF application descriptor field that embeds SHA-256(firmware.elf) into the app image, used to BIND the packaged firmware.elf to the policy-pinned firmware.bin.
app_descriptor.provenance: esp_app_desc_t.app_elf_sha256 for the pinned ESP32-C3 Arduino/IDF v4.4.6 image layout: the app image starts with esp_image_header_t (24 B) + one esp_image_segment_header_t (8 B); the first segment payload at file offset 0x20 is esp_app_desc_t, whose app_elf_sha256 member sits at struct offset 0x90, i.e. ABSOLUTE image offset 0x20 + 0x90 = 0xB0 (176). esptool.py elf2image writes SHA-256 of the whole firmware.elf here; `esptool image_info --version 2` prints the same 32 bytes.
app_descriptor.invariant: firmware.bin[176:208] MUST equal the raw SHA-256 digest of the packaged firmware.elf for every environment (proof category 'elf-binding'). Because firmware.bin is pinned byte-exact by environments[].sha256.firmware_bin, this binds the ELF proof input to the tracked app image: a swapped firmware.elf whose digest no longer matches these bytes is rejected.

reproducibility.description: Byte-reproducible-across-worktree-paths policy. The firmware envs are built with build_unflags=-ggdb + -g0 (see platformio.ini) so no absolute build-worktree path is embedded in DWARF; the same commit/toolchain therefore yields byte-identical firmware.elf/firmware.bin/firmware-merged.bin from any worktree path. Verified by building the final commit in two worktrees with materially different absolute path lengths and comparing all 15 (5 envs x elf/bin/merged) SHA-256 values.
reproducibility.elf_path_independence_note: proof category 'path-independence' asserts the packaged firmware.elf embeds NO absolute path referencing the build worktree: neither the current repository-root path (any Windows drive-case / slash spelling) nor the forbidden_elf_path_token project-family substring appears in firmware.elf. Espressif's precompiled SDK archives still carry their own stable (worktree-independent) debug paths under the pinned framework package; those are permitted and do not vary across worktrees.

proof_invariants_note: The per-environment binary proof spec (worker/diag/heap symbol + logging-string invariants; the firmware-merged.bin layout invariants: component SHA-256 at fixed offsets, app-region byte-equality to firmware.bin, exact merged length, and 0xFF gap fill; the exact policy SHA-256 anchors for firmware.elf/firmware.bin/firmware-merged.bin; the 'elf-binding' anchor that firmware.bin[app_descriptor.elf_sha256_offset] equals SHA-256(firmware.elf); and the 'path-independence' assertion that no build-worktree path is embedded in firmware.elf) is centrally defined in scripts/release-common.ps1 (Get-ProofSpec / Get-BinaryProofInvariants / Get-MergedLayoutInvariants) and re-derived byte-for-byte identically by build-release and verify-release. It binds the EXACT current-head binaries only and does not claim raw equivalence to any prior phase. The exact firmware.elf / firmware.bin / firmware-merged.bin SHA-256 anchors (environments[].sha256) plus app_descriptor and merged_layout are the tracked external anchors: the shipped merged image AND its proof-input ELF are bound to tracked Git policy and to each other, not to self-consistent manifest hashes.
